name: Diff Support
description: Diff and patch file support with syntax highlighting and GitHub-style previews.
detailedDescription:
## Diff and patch support

Review unified diff files with familiar syntax highlighting and a readable, GitHub-style side-by-side-inspired preview.

### Features

- TextMate syntax highlighting for `.diff` and `.patch` files
- Additions, deletions, context, file headers, and hunk headers are visually distinguished
- Scrollable preview with old and new line numbers
- No external language server required
